parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotation lid of the box, made of wood, rectangular in shape, and attached to the base body via a hinge mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the cover of the box, allowing the user to open or close the container to access or protect the contents inside.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a hinge axis, enabling an opening and closing motion relative to the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the box, made of plastic, forming the main storage compartment with rectangular geometry.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main storage space for holding items and supports the lid structure.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move; it serves as the fixed base for the rotating lid.
